scope: Consumed Dev mechanism falsification only. No protected Canary or Official Test access, representative effect estimate, SOTA claim, or leaderboard claim.
scientific_question: Does one real official-path target-state replay make a matched continuation repair more projects to EnvBench Official Pass than an equal continuation receiving typed-null feedback?

decision.trigger: Exactly one supporting causal chain and no C1-exclusive win, with at least four valid pairs.
decision.consequence: Retain exact official-path replay feedback only as a weak, narrow challenger. Do not promote it into the EnvSolve-Pro core and do not enter protected evaluation.
decision.live_frontier_status: killed; not tested or revived by M1c

interpretation: A strong continuous Agent solved six of nine historical nonpasses before a matched repair opportunity existed, so historical weak or earlier-session bad cases substantially overestimate the remaining repair surface.

Exact target-state feedback established one full causal repair chain for a bind-mounted Git ownership mismatch and induced the same targeted correction on a second Git-state case, but the second treatment never reached a terminal Official result.
The study does not establish a general dependency-resolution benefit. Tortoise-ORM showed a no-feedback pass while the treatment arm was censored, and qibo was already solved by C0.
Four of nine pairs were invalidated by external package delivery. This is a measurement bottleneck and must remain separate from semantic algorithm outcomes.

Official success alone hides large path-quality differences: qibo passed with a broad environment but required about 8.79 million input tokens and long repeated installations. Efficiency is a secondary evaluation axis, not a stopping threshold.

next_hypothesis_boundary.retain: Strong Agent continuous session plus complete-program target-state clean replay as an experimental primitive.
next_hypothesis_boundary.required_next_evidence: A preregistered independent consumed-Dev set of genuine C0 Official deployment failures must show at least two terminal T-exclusive Official repair chains under more reliable package delivery before replay feedback can enter the core algorithm.
